headline: Philip Morris International (PM) Wins FDA Modified Risk Status For ZYN In The US
summary: FDA authorizes Philip Morris International's ZYN nicotine pouches as modified risk tobacco products in the US. ZYN becomes the first and only smoke free nicotine pouch with this regulatory status in the US market. The decision recognizes PMI's harm reduction science and sets a new benchmark for smoke free alternatives. Philip Morris International (NYSE:PM) is expanding its smoke free portfolio, and the FDA's modified risk approval for ZYN puts a fresh spotlight on that shift. The company...
